SELECT DISTINCT
    'Neue_Kostenarten' AS quelle,
    a.kostenart,
    '' AS alias,
    CASE
        WHEN SUBSTR(a.kostenart, 1, 3) = 'KTO' THEN 'Konto'
        WHEN SUBSTR(a.kostenart, -3)   = 'GUV' THEN 'Kostenartengruppe (GUV)'
        WHEN SUBSTR(a.kostenart, -3)   = 'GV2' THEN 'Kostenartengruppe (GV2)'
        ELSE 'Sonstiger Knotenpunkt'
    END AS typ
FROM
    DTL_KST_BUCHUNGEN a
WHERE
    a.geschaeftsjahr >= 2025

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT
    'Neue_Kostenarten' AS quelle,
    a.kostenart,
    '' AS alias,
    'Konto' AS typ
FROM
    DTL_KST_BELEGE a
WHERE
    a.geschaeftsjahr >= 2025

ORDER BY
    2 ASC
